The band is 1.0%: 128.05 vs 127.9253 is about 0.1%, so it's within band. But the cluster is below the trusted price.

Hmm, maybe the trusted price is the agent's own target price, and the order is a step-up above the trusted price? The other agents are buying at lower prices (127.78–127.91), which are below the trusted price. So agent 85 is trying to buy at 128.05, which is above the cluster of other buy orders.
